resolution: Paint face-boundary seams: stabilized to a paintable state. History: rect-merge (req_1303) fixed intra-face row seams; a 3px edge-bleed (req_1304) hid face-boundary seams but, with the default 1-texel (~0.5px) gutter, overran into adjacent slots → red showed on an all-black neighbour (req_1305); widening the gutter to padTexels=6 then shrank face slots so the grey base dominated and faces wouldn't take visible paint (req_1306). Reverted to the default gutter (slots stay full-size + paintable) with a small 1px edge-bleed that covers most of the bilinear face-edge sample without the neighbour overrun. Texture repacked to name paint-v4 (one-time; resets paint). This is a stable, paintable compromise — faint residual seams may remain because the underlying cause is BILINEAR sampling across a per-face atlas at 512px. The DEFINITIVE fix is nearest-neighbour sampling of the paint texture (flat colours need no filtering → zero seams/bleed/overrun) — that is a global Scene3D sampler change (3d.zig g_diffuse_sampler is linear, shared with game textures; the game is PSX-styled so crisp/nearest likely suits it). Pending the user's call on flipping to nearest. Build clean; meshPaint 8/8. shas ddf600d37.
